sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]There is a Name I love to hear, I love to sing its [F#dim]worth;
[Em]It sounds like music [G]in my ears, The sweetest Name on [D7]earth.
[G]O how I love Jesus, O how I love Jesus,
[G]O how I love Jesus, [F#dim]Because He first loved [Bm]me.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]It tells me of a Savior's love,
[G]It tells me of a Savior's blood,

lines: [G]It tells of one whose loving heart
